question: Who was appointed as Special Director General of Jammu and Kashmir Police in August 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nalin Prabhat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nalin Prabhat**, a senior Indian Police Service (IPS) officer, was appointed as the Special Director General of Jammu and Kashmir Police in August 2024.
 
• He belongs to the **1992 batch of the IPS** from the Andhra Pradesh cadre.
 
• Nalin Prabhat has held significant positions in the past, including **Inspector General of Police (IGP) in various capacities** across multiple states.
 
• He is known for his expertise in **counter-insurgency operations** and extensive experience in tackling security challenges.
 
• His appointment comes at a crucial time to bolster the security and law enforcement mechanisms in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jammu and Kashmir Police:**

 
 
• The Jammu and Kashmir Police is responsible for maintaining law and order in the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• The force plays a crucial role in counter-terrorism operations and ensuring the safety of the region's citizens.
 
 
 
• **Special Director General:**
 
 
• The position of Special Director General is a high-ranking post in the Indian Police Service, reporting directly to the Director General of Police (DGP).
 
• The role often involves managing critical security and administrative operations within the police department.
 
 
 
• **Counter-Insurgency Operations in J&K:**
 
 
• Counter-insurgency operations are a major aspect of security in Jammu and Kashmir due to the region's history of militancy and cross-border terrorism.
 
• Such operations include intelligence gathering, neutralizing threats, and ensuring peace and stability in the area.
 
 
 
• **Indian Police Service (IPS):**
 
 
• The IPS is one of the All India Services of the Government of India responsible for law enforcement and public safety.
 
• IPS officers are recruited through the Civil Services Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC).
